title: H2O: Heavy-Hitter Oracle for Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models
domain: AI / large language model inference / KV-cache eviction

paper.version: arXiv revision generated 2023-12-20, matching the NeurIPS-era Figure 4

paper_alignment.paper_location: Section 5.1 and the top-left panel of Figure 4
paper_alignment.reproduced: The complete XSUM, LLaMA-7B, ROUGE-2 curve in the first Figure 4 panel: Full cache and the H2O/Local policies at 60%, 20%, 10%, and 4% KV-cache budgets, with the 100% point represented by Full.
paper_alignment.excluded: The other eleven Figure 4 panels, Tables 1-4, throughput and latency experiments, ablations, OPT, GPT-NeoX, CNN/DailyMail, and lm-eval-harness tasks are outside this task.

visual_inputs.purpose: Extract the Full, Heavy-Hitter Oracle, and Local ROUGE-2 values at every plotted KV Cache Budget for numeric comparison.

claims.statement: On the Figure 4 XSUM/LLaMA-7B experiment, H2O preserves ROUGE-2 close to the full-cache result through a 20% KV-cache budget and substantially outperforms the Local policy at the same 60%, 20%, and 10% budgets.
claims.source: Paper Section 5.1 and Figure 4, top-left panel (XSUM, LLaMA-7B, ROUGE-2).
claims.experiment: Use h2o_hf/run_helm.py and the pinned repository's h2o_hf/data/xsum.jsonl. Evaluate huggyllama/llama-7b locally on all 1000 fixed requests with one Full run; H2O at total budgets 60%, 20%, 10%, and 4% using equal heavy/recent ratios; and Local at the same budgets using only recent tokens. Score every generated-result file with the repository's bundled HELM ROUGE-2 implementation.
claims.acceptance: All nine distinct generation configurations and all 1000 examples per configuration are required. Support C1 only if every observed curve point is reported with its absolute error against the digitized reference, each non-100% point is within 1.0 ROUGE-2 of that reference, H2O exceeds Local by at least 2.0 ROUGE-2 at 60%, 20%, and 10%, and H2O at 20% is within 1.0 ROUGE-2 of Full. Missing budgets, fewer samples, a different checkpoint/dataset/prompt format/metric, or an inaccessible original checkpoint makes the result inconclusive.

requirements: Resolve and record the immutable Hugging Face model revision before downloading weights.
Run generation locally in FP16 on CUDA; do not replace LLaMA-7B with Llama-2, another mirror, a quantized checkpoint, or an API model for a supported verdict.
Keep the controller/vision API credentials outside the reproduced experiment and never pass them to repository code.
Record GPU, CUDA, PyTorch, Transformers, NumPy, HELM, and repository versions.

dataset.name: XSUM requests bundled by the official H2O repository
dataset.prompt_policy: Use the stored request prompts and per-request generation settings unchanged and in their original order.

metric.name: ROUGE-2
metric.implementation: The HELM evaluation code bundled in the pinned repository
metric.requirements: Use the same references, tokenization, normalization, and aggregation for every method and budget.

generation.settings: Preserve max_tokens, temperature, top_p, stop, n, and prompt from each stored request.

reported_results.source: Approximate values digitized from the top-left Figure 4 panel; these are visual references rather than underlying author result files.

artifact_requirements: Resolved model revision and complete environment manifest
The unmodified input-file SHA256 and exact example count
Raw generated JSONL for all nine distinct configurations
Raw HELM evaluation outputs and ROUGE-2 score for every configuration
A CSV or JSON table matching method and budget to expected value, observed value, absolute error, and relative error
A regenerated first-panel plot using the observed values

budget.expected_hardware: One CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU with at least 16 GB VRAM; 24 GB VRAM and at least 32 GB system RAM recommended

known_compatibility_issues: The original huggyllama/llama-7b checkpoint may require authorization or may no longer be available. A substituted model cannot support this paper-specific claim.
The repository targets older Transformers internals; current Transformers and PyTorch releases may require compatibility patches that must be documented.
Generation is stochastic even with a fixed seed, and CUDA/library changes can shift scores; preserve raw generations and report the exact environment.
The paper prose and bundled XSUM prompt files are not fully explicit about shot construction. Use the pinned xsum.jsonl unchanged and report this paper-code ambiguity.
The numeric targets were digitized from a plotted curve and are approximate; the task therefore uses an absolute ROUGE-2 tolerance instead of exact equality.
